# Assets · Maps

4 files under `assets/Maps/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for america_region_map.svg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

Region maps for the affiliate / plant overview: america_region_map.svg, eu_region_map.svg, mea_region_map.png and world_map_svg.png (a 2x PNG render; the source SVG embedded a raster). Plot plant markers over them; keep the map neutral.
